people.name: David

people.name: Jerusalem

translations.web: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
translations.kjv: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
translations.asv: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion; the same is the city of David.
